_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The onboarding card tops the Assistant's transcript until dismissed. The server runs in workspace mode. Until call "stop overriding", the workspace the page loads says the onboarding card was not dismissed, and the onboarding details say: no text number, not connected, exe.dev integration "acme-exe", VM host "NAME.exe.test"; after it, the page gets the server's own. Call "dismissed" returns the server's onboarding_dismissed ("true" or "false"). "The card" is the element with data-testid "onboarding"; "the message input" is data-testid "message-input"; "the sent message" is the first element inside ".messages-list" whose text contains "echo: onboarding card". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. The card should be visible. 3. Click the card's element with data-testid "onboarding-web-app" (Build a web app prefills a prompt for the user to finish). 4. The message input's value should come to contain "through the acme-exe integration". 5. Its value should come to match the regular expression /make it public with `share set-public NAME`[\s\S]*\n\nThe app: $/ (the prompt ends with a blank line, then "The app: "). 6. Fill the message input with "echo: onboarding card". 7. Click the element with data-testid "send-button". 8. The sent message should be visible. 9. The card must still be in the page (exactly 1). 10. Eval this; it must return true (the sent message lands below the card): [...document.querySelectorAll(".messages-list *")].some((m) => m.textContent === "echo: onboarding card" && !!(document.querySelector('[data-testid="onboarding"]').compareDocumentPosition(m) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING)). 11. Eval the card's scrollIntoView(). 12. Call "stop overriding". 13. Click the card's element with data-testid "onboarding-dismiss". 14. There should be exactly 0 cards. 15. Reload. 16. The sent message should be visible. 17. There must be exactly 0 cards. 18. Call "dismissed": it must return "true" (dismissing is the server's, so it survives reloads).

steps.expression: /make it public with `share set-public NAME`[\s\S]*\n\nThe app: $/.test(document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value)
